title: Childhood Trauma Test
description: Look at the traces of childhood experiences that may still shape your emotions and relationships today.

questions.ctq_1: My parents or caregivers often called me stupid, naughty, or other belittling names.
questions.ctq_2: I often felt that no one in my family truly loved me.
questions.ctq_3: My parents often couldn't take care of me because they were too busy or absent.
questions.ctq_4: I was physically punished to the point of bruises or injuries.
questions.ctq_5: I felt I had to protect my parents emotionally, instead of them protecting me.
questions.ctq_6: My basic needs (clean food, decent clothes, seeing a doctor) were sometimes neglected.
questions.ctq_7: A family member acted in ways that made me feel physically unsafe.
questions.ctq_8: My parents often fought so badly that they threw things or got physically violent.
questions.ctq_9: I was often left home alone for long periods when I was too young.
questions.ctq_10: I felt safe and protected at home.
questions.ctq_11: My parents gave me demands or responsibilities that were too heavy for a child my age.
questions.ctq_12: Affection in my family was only given when I achieved something.
questions.ctq_13: I was often afraid of one or both of my parents' anger.
questions.ctq_14: My family was very closed off, and I didn't feel comfortable bringing friends home.
questions.ctq_15: I was often mocked or humiliated by family members in front of others.
questions.ctq_16: As a child, I had at least one adult who truly cared about me and whom I could rely on.
questions.ctq_17: I was made to feel that my family would be better off without me.
questions.ctq_18: When I was sad or cried, I was often told to be quiet or scolded.
questions.ctq_19: I often saw my mother or female caregiver being treated harshly.
questions.ctq_20: The punishments I received were often far out of proportion to the small mistakes I made.
questions.ctq_21: My parents often threatened to abandon or leave me as a way to discipline me.
questions.ctq_22: Overall, I feel my childhood was as happy as most children's.

results.description: You have a relatively safe and supportive childhood foundation.
There were some less-than-ideal childhood experiences, but they don't dominate your life now.
Childhood wounds have left a mark and may affect how you respond to conflict or relationships today.
Past experiences strongly affect your emotional well-being. Working with a professional is highly recommended for healing.
